name: lgeneral
desc: Turn-based strategy engine heavily inspired by Panzer General
why: Open-source turn-based strategy engine in the Panzer General mould; a strong, unusual game for a long afternoon.

brief.what_it_is: LGeneral is an open-source turn-based strategy engine modeled on Panzer General. You play single scenarios or whole campaigns turn by turn against a human opponent or the AI. It needs the Panzer General game data, either the pg-data.tar.gz archive or the original DOS game, which the lgc-pg converter turns into the format the engine reads. The homepage lists the engine and converter source, a map editor, a Win32 port with PG and K.u.K. data included, and a Flathub package.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage gives no separate motivation; it presents LGeneral as an engine heavily inspired by Panzer General that adds depth through its own systems.
brief.how_it_works: The engine runs scenarios and campaigns turn by turn on top of SDL (>= 1.1.4). The lgc-pg converter reads the original Panzer General data (from pg-data.tar.gz or the DOS game) and produces the data the engine uses. Sound is optional through SDL Mixer, and the engine runs without it.

commands_seen.context: From the Homebrew caveats (brew metadata, not the homepage): converts the unzipped pg-data into the lgeneral share directory. The homepage points to README.lgc-pg for data installation but I did not fetch that file.

brief.install_notes: Panzer General data is required and not bundled with the source: get pg-data.tar.gz from SourceForge or use the original DOS game. Per the Homebrew caveats, run lgc-pg with -s pointing at the unzipped data directory and -d pointing at the lgeneral share directory under the Homebrew prefix. The homepage says data installation is explained in README.lgc-pg, which I did not read. Alternatives: K.u.K. data (kukgen-data-1.1.1.zip) needs no conversion, and the Win32 zip ships with PG and K.u.K. data.
brief.standout: It is an engine that plays the Panzer General ruleset with extras like entrenchment, rugged defense, defensive fire, surprise contacts, unit supply, weather and reinforcements. The K.u.K. WWI scenario package is a free standalone option that needs no original game data.
brief.status: unknown. The homepage lists version 1.4.4 with downloads, a Flathub package, and a Debian maintainer for the K.u.K. data, which suggests active packaging, but the page shows no release dates and I did not check the repository or commit history.
brief.caveats: Requires Panzer General data (pg-data.tar.gz or the DOS game) for the main game; the data is not included in the source tarball. Per the Homebrew caveats, sound and music are not supported in this build. The homepage notes the Win32 zip has no installer. The newer map editor and the K.u.K. package need SDL2, SDL2_ttf and SDL2_image.
quotes: LGeneral is a turn-based strategy engine heavily inspired by Panzer General.
You play single scenarios or whole campaigns turn by turn against a human player or the AI.

Entrenchment, rugged defense, defensive fire, surprise contacts, surrender, unit supply, weather influence, reinforcements and other implementations contribute to the tactical and strategic depth of the game.
